integrity: Analytical derivation uses elementary line-plane incidence, spherical polygon area, active constraint geometry, monotonicity, and Taylor expansion. Finite simulation and angular quadrature checks are corroborative, not proofs. No independent audit or certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Equilateral centered base, two axial heights positive, and Haar-uniform orthogonal planar projections; the statistic is simultaneous nonvisibility of both apices, not the entire number-of-shadow-vertices distribution. It does not address skew bases or other projection distributions. The preceding symmetric special case is not a newly claimed discovery. Priority risk from specialized finite-polytope silhouette literature remains.
title: A sharp two-apex invisibility law for asymmetric triangular bipyramids
